## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue with `Fixes #123` or explain why no issue is needed. Keep repository communication in English.

## Verification

List the checks run and any remaining limitations. Add or update meaningful tests where appropriate. Do not automatically run 30-minute endurance tests for ordinary pull requests.

## Risks

Describe compatibility, runtime or migration implications when applicable. Confirm that no secrets, real environment files, private setup links, or production data are included.

<!-- Follow CONTRIBUTING.md. For ordinary coding PRs, add documentation changes or screenshots only when explicitly requested. -->
